text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) has arrived. Just 
when everyone thought the "BNW" rematch 
would finally take place on the grounds of 
Hanshin—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Winning Ticket sidelined due to 
injury, the race turned into a 
head-to-head showdown between Narita 
Taishin and Biwa Hayahide.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Will Narita Taishin's closing burst 
prevail, or will Biwa Hayahide's winning 
formula take the crown—?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A battle where neither side was willing to 
yield an inch was just about to begin.
